classification.conformanceProfile: OCI Image Format 1.1 bounded single-platform Linux/amd64 image profile

formatPolicy.standard: OCI Image Format 1.1.1 / OCI Image Layout
formatPolicy.artifactIdentity: OCI manifest descriptor digest from the final OCI layout
formatPolicy.transportBoundary: builder/container-storage identities are source evidence only; final Artifact identity is taken after Skopeo normalization into OCI layout
formatPolicy.sbom: Syft SPDX 2.3 JSON bound to exact OCI manifest digest
formatPolicy.vulnerabilityIntelligence: Trivy 0.73 scan bound to frozen DB snapshot 20260912-r1
formatPolicy.secretScanning: Trivy secret scan over rootfs exported from final OCI-layout read-back image
formatPolicy.runtimeReadback: Skopeo imports final OCI layout into an isolated temporary Podman tag; Podman executes with network=none

contractSchema.claim: software-release object contract is valid under software-release-oci-contract-v1

ociIdentity.claim: OCI layout/index/manifest/config/layer descriptors are internally digest/size consistent and manifest identity matches the contract

platformConfig.claim: OCI config platform, entrypoint and working directory match the object contract

rootfsReadback.claim: final OCI layout can be imported independently and exported rootfs files match contract digests

sbom.claim: Syft emits SPDX 2.3 JSON whose CONTAINER root is bound to the exact final manifest digest and required packages are present

vulnerabilityScan.claim: Trivy offline vulnerability scan over final rootfs uses the exact frozen DB snapshot and remains within contract count

secretScan.claim: Trivy secret scan over final rootfs remains within contract count

runtimeReadback.claim: final OCI-layout read-back image executes with network disabled and exact contract exit/stdout/stderr behavior

nonClaims: that Artifact E2E built the software; build authorship remains Engineer-side
that SPDX 2.3 is ISO/IEC 5962:2021; that ISO standard corresponds to SPDX 2.2.1
absence of vulnerabilities outside the exact frozen Trivy DB snapshot
absence of runtime vulnerabilities not detectable from static rootfs/package evidence
production deployment safety, scalability or service reliability
signature/provenance trust beyond the separate common SLSA/in-toto/Sigstore release envelope
registry authorization, replication or retention policy
